messages:
harper: Quick coordination for Monday's announce. Need engineering to lock final changelog URL + a tiny migration note for the post. Target publish: Mon 09:00 PT. Any timing constraints from infra?
lee: I'll provide the canonical links by EOD. Marketing wants a single short landing URL that redirects to: release-notes, migration-checklist, and webinar CTA.
dina: I'll create the redirect and add anchors: #whats-new, #migration, #webinar. Also adding a short '3 highlights' snippet for the header.
harper: Great. Canary plan? Ops asked for an explicit window and PD owners.
lee: Proposed: 09:00 PT small canary (15m) -> gradual ramp to 40% over 45m -> hold 60m -> full at +2:00 if green. Auto-fallback rules: if 5xx > 0.15% for 5m OR p95 latency increases >12% -> rollback.
dina: I'll put those thresholds into the ops runbook and expose them in the release page. Also including a short migration snippet: "1) Pin current model. 2) Run 10% canary. 3) Verify p95 and 5xx, then ramp."
harper: Inbound lead routing: marketing form should set X-Region and utm_campaign so Sales can split NA/EMEA/APAC. Who will own the routing table?
lee: infra team will own it; sample payload ready from release-bot.
release-bot: infra-bot: staging example: ```http
POST /register
Headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Region":"APAC","X-Source":"announce-2024-10"}
Body: {"email":"alex@example.com","company":"Acme"}
```
harper: Messaging: need two subject lines for an A/B (12h) and a tweet-sized line. Drafts?
dina: Subjects: A) "Safer LLM rollouts: new canary tooling + migration guides" B) "Ship LLM features faster with smarter batching and rollback"
dina: Tweet copy: "Release: smarter batching, KV cache, and safer canary rollouts to cut inference cost and risk. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/oct2024"
harper: Blog header (3 lines): "Launching targeted rollout tooling for production LLMs. Smarter batching and KV cache reduce unit cost. Join our webinar for a live demo (Mon 09:00 PT)."
lee: Final changelog link will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-10/changelog.html — I'll post the commit hash when live. PD: eng-oncall -> lee, eng-sre -> rachel. Reminder set for 08:40 PT.
harper: Perfect. I'll assemble the assets (tweet, two subjects, header image, short migration bullets) and post the final announce plan before midnight PT. Thanks all :tada:
